The private AI lab on Robinhood. Darkwoods pioneers the future of decentralised, censorship resistant, private AI. Powerful open weight models in a fully private environment with tailored agent tools.

Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.
Hold $ORBIO, earn OpenRouter credits. Half of trading fees are converted into inference credits and paid to holders, in dollars.

Bundlecat (BUN) is the first token launched on Mosh, a token launch protocol developed by UV Labs and deployed on Robinhood Chain. Mosh pairs new token launches with autonomous AI market-making agents. Under the Mosh model, token bundles are crowd-funded by participants and permanently locked in non-custodial smart contract vaults at the moment of launch. AI agents then use the locked tokens to provide liquidity and generate buy-side market activity, operating within contract-enforced rules that no individual, including the Mosh team, can override. Baby Cash Cat is fan fiction with a ticker. The story starts before the green app, before the IPO, and before a chain built for “serious” finance. Two founders needed a name. One option on the table was Cash Cat: a cat sitting on money, cute on purpose, made for regular people who just wanted a shot. It was not grand enough. Someone said it lacked power. A better story won — Robin Hood of finance, fighting for the little guy — and the cat got left in a drawer.
